Corollary
[aspherical nonnegative-Ricci manifolds are flat]

Source: petersen:page-0320, petersen:page-0321 ↗ thm:pet-ch7-structure-theorem 1. ch7:7.3.13Suppose $(M,g)$ is compact with $\Ric \ge 0$. If $M$ is a $K(\pi ,1)$ (its universal cover is contractible), then the universal cover is Euclidean space and $(M,g)$ is flat.
Proof

↗ cor:pet-ch7-flat-manifold-Kpi1 \sketch By subsection 3.3, $\widetilde M=N\times \mathbb R^k$ with $N$ compact. Contractibility of $\widetilde M$ forces $N$ to be a point, so $\widetilde M=\mathbb R^n$ and the metric is flat.

□
